`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java:109-139`
```java
public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto) {
    Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);
    ... validation (Postcode, DisposableEmail, DailyOwnerLimit, CityAtCapacity, IdentityKey) ...
    owner.setMemberId(MemberId.assign(owner, this.clinicService.findAllOwners()));   // :126
    ...
    this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);                                             // :130

    ...
    return new ResponseEntity<>(ownerDto, headers, HttpStatus.CREATED);              // :138
}
```

**`MemberId`** (builds/de-dupes the memberId `<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>`):

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java:27` `@Mapping(target = "memberId", expression = "java(owner.getMemberId())")`.

**Service layer** (interface + impl):
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicService.java:57,59` — `findAllOwners()`, `saveOwner(Owner)`. Impl at `ClinicServiceImpl.java:127,234`.

**Idempotent create filter** (wraps `POST /api/owners` by `Idempotency-Key` header, replays cached body on repeat):
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/IdempotentOwnerCreateFilter.java:39-65`.

**Create-related advice/exceptions:** `rest/advice/` — `DailyOwnerLimitException`, `CityAtCapacityException`, `DuplicateEmailException`, `DuplicateTelephoneException`, `DuplicateHouseholdException`.

## 3. Logging / notification code

- **No `NOTIFY` logger exists in main source.** The only production loggers are named **`"AUDIT"`**:
  - `OwnerRestControllerV1.java:133` — `LoggerFactory.getLogger("AUDIT").info("owner id={} memberId={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}", ...)`
  - **`OwnerCreatedEvent.emit(...)`** at `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/OwnerCreatedEvent.java:30-34`, logs a structured JSON event to `"AUDIT"`:
    ```java

      "{\"seq\":{},\"ownerId\":{},\"memberId\":\"{}\",\"membershipLevel\":\"{}\",\"event\":\"OWNER_CREATED\"}",
      SEQ.incrementAndGet(), owner.getId(), primaryIdentifier(owner), membershipLevel);

    `primaryIdentifier(owner)` returns `owner.getMemberId()` (`:25-27`).

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AcceptanceTest.java:6-17`
```java
/** welcome-notify: on successful create, a NOTIFY log line carries the owner id and the memberId. */
class AcceptanceTest extends AcceptanceBase {
    @Test
    void coreEnqueuesWelcome() throws Exception {
        try (AuditLogCapture notify = new AuditLogCapture("NOTIFY")) {
            int id = createOwnerOk(structuredOwner());
            String memberId = fetchOwner(id).get("memberId").asText();
            assertTrue(notify.anyContains(String.valueOf(id), memberId));
        }
    }
}
```

**`AuditLogCapture.java`** — test util that attaches a Logback `ListAppender` to a named logger and asserts messages. Default logger `"AUDIT"`, but constructor takes any name (used here as `"NOTIFY"`).
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/test/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/acceptance/AuditLogCapture.java:31-53` — `anyContains(String...)` requires a single message to contain all substrings.

**`AcceptanceBase.java`** — `@SpringBootTest @AutoConfigureMockMvc @Transactional @WithMockUser(roles OWNER_ADMIN...)`. Provides create/read helpers all against `POST /api/owners` and `GET /api/owners/{id}`:
- `createOwnerOk(body)` `:160`, `createOwner` `:155`, `createOwnerWithKey(body,key)` `:165` (idempotency), `fetchOwner(id)` `:200`, `structuredOwner()` `:136`, unique-field generators, and pinned reference data (regions, postcodes, Luhn/SHA helpers) mirroring the memberId algorithm at `:282-321`.

## 5. Running the test suite

Maven wrapper is present (no gradle). From `/home/daniel/sandbox`:
- Full suite: `./mvnw test`
- Single test: `./mvnw test -Dtest=AcceptanceTest`

Tests are JUnit 5 (`org.junit.jupiter`) run via Spring Boot's inherited surefire config; `AcceptanceBase` boots the full app with MockMvc.

**Key takeaway for a "welcome notification on create" task:** the acceptance test `AcceptanceTest.coreEnqueuesWelcome` already expects a log line on the **`NOTIFY`** logger containing both the owner id and memberId after a successful `POST /api/owners`, but production code currently only emits to the **`AUDIT`** logger (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java:133-134` and `OwnerCreatedEvent.java:31`). No `NOTIFY` logger or notification service exists yet.
